fieldValues.title: Note
fieldValues.description: A Tier 0 instance: a titled set of named free-text sections with no Type binding and therefore no field-level semantics. It exists so that material can be captured at the moment it appears, before anyone knows what shape it should take. A Note has a stable instance id, may carry tags and source references, and may be the target of Relations from the Records it later gave rise to.
fieldValues.notes: Section names must be unique within a Note (Invariant 18). Tags on a Note are keys that may, but need not, resolve to a Term in an open vocabulary.
